meta.name: eol-stakeholder-sequence
meta.description: Plan who to talk to about a sunset, in what order, and what each conversation must cover. Use when an EOL decision is made and you want the landmines found before the announcement.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 规划下架前与各方沟通的先后顺序和要点
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果计划产品下架，需要在公告前梳理关键沟通对象与内容。
copy.tagline_en: Plan who to talk to about a sunset, in what order, and what to cover.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you plan a product sunset and need to map key conversations before the announcement.

howto.what: 产品要停用时，Claude 按“法律/法务、财务、销售/客服等对外角色”的顺序排出谈话清单；每一站注明找谁、为什么、需要对方提供什么、要回馈什么、警惕哪些红旗信号，以及这次谈话必须产出什么结果。
howto.when: 当停用决定已做出、你询问“先找谁谈、按什么顺序”时触发。也可直接提供产品与已知范围，让它直接生成顺序。

say.text: 我准备停掉旧报表模块，先找谁谈？按什么顺序推进？
say.note: 会先请你选轻/标准/重级别，再输出分站顺序。

say.text: 这是标准规模产品停用，请排出含法务、财务、销售、客服的完整谈话序列。
say.note: 会按默认标准级别生成约 7–8 站的清单。

say.text: 一条硬件产品线要停用，有8家经销商，标出哪些可并行、哪些必须串行。
say.note: 会生成较重级别清单并标出依赖关系。

howto.what_en: Claude builds an ordered stakeholder itinerary for a retired product. Each stop covers whom to see, why, what to ask for, what you owe them, red flags, and the conversation's required output. Default order begins with Legal, then Finance, then Sales/Support-facing roles.
howto.when_en: Triggers when an EOL decision is already made and you ask whom to contact and in what sequence. Example: "We're retiring the legacy reporting module; who should we brief and when?"

say_en.text: Retiring our legacy reporting module — who first, in what order?
say_en.note: Asks you to pick a level, then produces an ordered stop list.

say_en.text: Standard sunset: include Legal, Finance, Sales, Support in the order.
say_en.note: Builds the default Level-2 itinerary (about 7–8 stops).

say_en.text: Hardware sunset with 8 resellers: mark sequential vs parallel calls.
say_en.note: Builds a Level-3 itinerary and marks dependencies.
